mechanism: The actual capture factory reuses unchanged capture_dependencies/dependency_inventory/inventory_digest and real Git-lock verification. No JSON verified flag mints the immutable tree capability.

The genuine launcher explicitly mounts the complete capture root RO; the immutable bound tree requires that exact actual launch/role and mount record. This first adapter uses the same absolute physical and visible root, not the Preparers per-role mount translation.

Only actual selected-trace events with supported readonly open/metadata flags and ENOENT can produce facts. The component follows exact internal aliases and types to the first missing component. Existing files, intermediate regular files, unknown roots, source inputs, wrong flags/errno, missing file/mount bindings, foreign launches and unobserved events fail.
Successful dependency bytes remain exact ordinary dependency FileBindings. Existing PID/cwd/dirfd interpretation is reused; no second goal/scope engine or inverse QA graph is introduced.
Recorder snapshots are always preserved before interpretation; unknown PID values remain errors with exact recorder line/PID diagnostics.

actualToolCapture.scope: Complete privately copied root of five tool packages for this bounded probe; no claim that this is the full installed app/node_modules or an accepted production Source-A dependency pin.

actualTs.prefixFactMeaning: The same bound absence prover is exercised on actual absolute failed tool lookups before the first OS blocker. Five leaf/intermediate absences per role. This is not a completed full source-read authentication report.

newRuntimeBoundary.executables: Actual Node CLI group2 and spawned Node group13, with one worker-thread read in each group per role. It is not the esbuild executable.
newRuntimeBoundary.nodeProvenance: Separately bound actual root Node executable, outside the dependency capture; captured CLI/preflight/loader argument files are independently bound by the capture hash.
newRuntimeBoundary.operations: openat O_RDONLY|O_CLOEXEC, successful one-byte read, close; exact Host-PID/group, local group PID, kernel release/boot and trace snapshot SHA are recorded.

historicalCurrentTaskOutcomes.initialUnitFailures: The first unit fixture placed its binary outside visible /dev/shm mounts and its remove/type case could empty all regular files. The fixture was corrected without loosening capture/readonly checks.
historicalCurrentTaskOutcomes.unitEvidenceFilenameCollision: A later unit run exited1 while saving two actual launches to one evidence filename; the second ordinary launch now has distinct candidate-role evidence.
historicalCurrentTaskOutcomes.initialTsLaunchParserFailure: The initial TS command exited1 at unknown getpid formatting. Its actual raw carrier and error execution remain preserved. A later replay of the available file is not substituted as the original interpreted snapshot or an accepted original run. Cause not proven.
historicalCurrentTaskOutcomes.followingTsBlocked: The second actual TS pair exited0 and blocked at the same OS path; preserved separately before the final prefix-proof export.

limits: No Source-A164/593 validation, actual prepared pair mount adapter, full Deep/CQR producer, AQA02/03, runtime/state activation, M6/M7 restoration or CI wiring.
Same absolute physical/visible dependency mount root only; the Preparers role-specific app/node_modules mount mapping remains unimplemented.
The small TS producer exits0 and reads actual differing role IDs, but complete read authentication remains blocked; five prefix facts do not grant QA validity.
No /proc/sys prefix or per-executable runtime permission has been added. OS content is volatile, not immutable curriculum data.
No new active escape or recorder-manipulation program. Existing negative regression controls were rerun; new checks are normal owned-file/metadata/capability checks.
Tree/alias/byte verification currently rechecks the complete small capture per proof. Full-tree performance is not measured or claimed.
The initial unknown-getpid parser failure is preserved and remains unexplained; the new protected exact snapshot improves future diagnostics without skipping unknown values.
No general confidential-host, arbitrary-Linux-tool hermeticity or external-writer ABA guarantee.
